response.reason: The cited clause (Art. 18(2)) requires that ingredients be designated by their specific name, in accordance with Article 17 and Annex VI. However, the verdict turns on the requirement for a quantitative ingredient declaration (QUID) when an ingredient appears in the name of the food. The cited clause does not establish the QUID requirement; that is found elsewhere in Regulation (EU) No 1169/2011, specifically in Article 22 and Annex VIII. Therefore, the clause is insufficient to ground the QUID aspect of the verdict.
